Ok. I'm sure for Harry Potter fans this couldn't be more exciting. For me, it was just some props. The digital audio guide cost extra, and was just confusing. There was a learning curve to operate it. I expect more from a "studio tour".
Maybe I expected too much. Oh, the food service is crap. Theme park pricing and quality or lack thereof.

Went on a tour which was for 6-7 hours depending on traffic. Which gave us 4 hours at the centre. Which was about right. We knew not to drag our heels.. but in reality we went a bit fast and finished up about 30 mins early. So take your time. Read everything. We did see and read a lot but we could have done it slower.
It was amazing. Really good. All authentic. Well guided. We didn't use a personal guide but we asked heaps from the well placed concierges..they told lots of cool stories!
So a great day out well worth going with Evans and Evans just for the sheer ease hassle free!!
Everyone was very kind, they are all great fan of Harry Potter. Amazing all the tricks of the movies...

This place was much bigger than expected. You can spend a large portion of your day here. So many things to see and special photo opportunities. The sights are truly amazing and a must see for any fan in the London area.

I have been a fan of all things Harry Potter since I can remember, and at 27 years old, to FINALLY be able to step into the world and see all the sets, props, costumes ect with my own eyes was truly a dream come true. I had tears in my eyes when I first arrived and just continued throughout. Having the music in the background gives it the extra special touch.
Tried to Butterbeer and I actually loved it! Have seen some mixed reviews but I was a fan, very sweet but delicious.
Highlight was walking through the Gringotts set (took my breath away it was stunning) then going through to the other side once destroyed with an excellent display, I won’t spoil it for future visitors!
Transport there and back was super easy and comfortable.
And there is an AMAZING gift shop at the end with all the HP memorabilia you could ask for.
Great day!

My husband & I recently visited London & naturally wanted to pay a visit to the Warner Bros. Studio. We booked our tour through Viator which partners with Evan Evans. For the most part, the experience was good - it was easy to check-in, get on the bus, & the ride there was uneventful. The studio tour was incredible & we had an amazing time exploring the behind-the-scenes of the Harry Potter movies.

The trouble began when we returned to the bus to return home. The individual who checked us in + the bus driver were both incredibly clear that if you were not boarded by the departure time, you would be left behind. They even went as far as to provide return instructions. Considering we had four full hours to explore, getting done in time did not seem to be a concern & it ultimately wasn't as we were done well before the departure time. The individual who checked us in & the driver also made it abundantly clear that anyone who arrived before the scheduled boarding time of 4:20 would be required to wait & to "not arrive" until that time. The time to return was provided as we departed the bus & was also printed on our wristband.

Around 4:00, we decided to wrap up & head outside, but since it was well before the boarding time, we hung around the entrance of the studios until about 4:12. At that time, we headed over & were at the bus at least 3-4 minutes before the communicated boarding time. We were met with a full bus & the driver told us that we would need to go to the bus behind us as there was "no room". Mind you, it's barely 4:20 at this point - the time we were told multiple times that we would not be able to board before. We headed to the bus behind us & were told we couldn't get on as we had the wrong colored wristbands, but the driver seemed to have experienced this before & had a word with the other bus driver. We were then instructed to head to the original one as they "found" two seats. We approach that bus & very loudly the bus driver asked if we were lost multiple times. Mind you, he was the one that told us there was no room, so it was clear he was trying to make us look like we were the ones who made a mistake. It's rather uncomfortable when someone tries to make you look stupid in front of a bus full of people, regardless of whether or not they're paying attention.

The real kicker? When I sat down, I realized that the clock at the front of the bus was a full ten minutes early, so apparently they run on their own team. In all, we had a great day thanks to our time at the studio, but Evan Evans Tours needs to fix their clocks & work with their employees on how they communicate to guests.

How ironic to receive a request to review our Evans Evans tour the day after our scheduled tour! We had showed up for a tour at the appointed time, only to learn that our "e-ticket", which included the statement that "...this ticket is only valid once...", was issued in error by "the system." The excuse that the ambiguous email sent shortly after the e-ticket was issued, indicating that there was no availability on our requested dates and times (but not specifically advising that the e-tickets were issued in error) is hollow, especially as there was another family who had also experienced the cost, inconvenience and disappointment of a "systems error." It's Evans Evans' system that failed.

A very happy harry potter fan!

Was a great experience, great atmosphere!
Booked through get your guide

All the rooms and props were amazing

The cafe could have more options for food and the butter beer was disgusting but of course i had to try .

I would highly recommend this tour for any Harry Potter fans and its family friendly

Tip- if you booked online go to the window before lining up to print your ticket , i made the mistake of lining up in a loooong line just to be told to go back and print it at another window.

Heads up the bus ride is pretty long to get there and the bus leaves exactly on time so dont be late!

Today's next pour, a delicious Hogsmeade Butter Beer! At the Warner Bros Harry Potter Studios outside of London! What an amazing experience this place is! A 7 hour tour with Evan Evans Tours - 80 minute bus ride each way and 4 hours touring the real movie sets, props, costumes, and special effects. Warner Bros did this right.

You see the complete sets of the Gryffindor Common Rooms, Hagrid's cottege interior, all of Dumbledore's huge office, the Potions classroom, the massive Gringott's Bank, the Lastrange bank vault and Diagon Alley. Lots of "how it was done" displays, video demonstrations, interactive green screen activities, animatronic props, and much more.

You really get an understanding of just how much work went into the making of these 8 movies over 10 years, and that the actors not only have probably the easiest jobs, but how much they appreciate the crew, set designers, costumers, etc.

Yes, there is so much to do in London, but this experience is well worth the time - not only for Harry Potter fans, but for any movie fan!

Educational with friendly staff and an altogether great experience. Highly recommended for Harry Potter fans

If you want to explore London a little better since we got to take the train this time (other times we have done tube and buses)...try this guided round trip. Having a guide helped us avoid long lines at the entrance, it was filled with great information, special access, lots of time to explore/eat/shop on your own as well. Overall for a family of 6 hooked on Harry Potter, this was THE highlight of our trip....oh the butter beer alone is worth this trip.

First time going to this attraction and definitely won’t be the last such an amazing place, it was great to see how all the magic was really made and great to see all the sets. Gringotts bank was unbelievable felt like I was actually in the movie.
Warner brothers never disappoint. Although I would have like to have more than 4 hours in the studio. The photo opportunists were fun. Ice cream tasted so good
Amazing tour. Staff were friendly and helpful. Our driver was very chatty and helpful, everyone went out of their way to help you. HP studios tour itself was fantastic.

This is an amazing day and won't disappoint. 3.5 hours was plenty of time. Try the Butter Beer!
The staff were extremely helpful and efficient and when they realised that the bus was overbooked they booked us a car to take us there and then pick us up and drop us directly at our hotel.

If you have even remotely heard of Harry Potter, run to this tour! I cried when we walked into the great hall and gasped at Gringott’s, and the full scale model of Hogwart’s was so amazing.

Also, get the butterbeer and splurge on the sticky toffee pudding in the cafe in the main lobby. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
The Warner Bros. Studio tour was amazing! I highly recommend it to all HP fans as a must see/go to when in the London area.

This is a great tour for Harry Potter fans. It is about an hour away from London and around 4 hours at the location. This tour can take most of your day. You can get to see a lot of the props and behind-the-scenes information about the movies where the movies were filmed. If you are not a fan of Harry Potter, skip this tour.

The bus ride was supposed to have Wifi, but we didn't have any on the way to the studio. The bus on the way back did however. We were also supposed to get an audio guide, but one was not included when we got to the studio. There was also no live English guide unless you count the person at the studio who spoke to everyone for about 5 minutes when we first entered into the main hall of the studio. Lastly, we had purchased 2 adult tickets plus a youth ticket, which it clearly stated on our voucher, but they told us we had to pay extra because our 10 year old was too old for the ticket we purchased. We clearly had paid the appropriate price, but they argued with us and would not let us on the bus until we paid extra for it. We had booked our tickets through a 3rd party company Viator, who confirmed that we had purchased the right ticket and that they had sent the correct information to Evan Evans tours. We felt like we had been taken advantage of because they knew we would pay extra since at that point it was our only chance to go. I will avoid Evan Evans Tours in the future. The costumes, props and sets at Warner Brothers Studio were really great. Just book your transportation elsewhere.

We are huge Harry Potter fans and this tour was unbelievable!!!! The ride was very comfortable and on time. Everything was exactly as they said on their website. Warner Brothers studio was amazing! I had tears in my eyes, from excitement, obviously! 😊. A must for your kids and teens who have read all the books and seen all the movies!!! 👍. Well worth the money.

This was worth the price of admission. If you are a Harry Potter fan then this is a must see. You get to see where the actual movies were filmed. The model of Hogwarts is unbelievable. Definitely worth the trip.

As fans of the Harry Potter books and movies, this tour was a treat for us. There was more to see and do than we expected. The recently-opened Gringotts Bank set is impressive, and the hands-on opportunities abound. We strongly recommend this for Potter fans. Allow about 3-4 hours. You should know that backtracking through the studio is not allowed, and, for timing purposes, the cafeteria is about halfway through the exhibits.

Due to an unfortunate lack of communication (not by Evan & Evans, but rather elsewhere), my boyfriend and I were unable to attend the Warners Bros Tours as we had planned on doing during our trip to London. We were extremely disappointed and frustrated, but the staff at Evan & Evans made their apologies well-known and attempted to make other arrangements for us during our short stay there. We were unable to fit it into our schedule, but I would definitely try to book through them if I return because of they went out of their way to try to accommodate our travel plans.

This was an amazing trip. Easy trip from London. Had plenty of time for the tour plus coffee afterwards. Easily enough entertainment to fill the whole time - mix of walking through sets, reading info about filming, videos, and interactive exhibits. Great day!

We went there on a thursday, with the first bus. Lots of people, but we were still able to see most of the stuff inside the museum. Fun to see all the stuff they made for the movies. Really recommend going!

The pickup point for the bus is in middle of London and was easy to find.

Just got back from an amazing experience. Everything at this attraction is well laid out. The exhibits are magnificent allowing you to see in close details the sets used in the making of these films. Our 2 teens are Harry Potter mad so it was a given that they would enjoy. Wasn’t expecting to enjoy it as much having not seen the films but it is spectacular to see how they created the sets. Took a well earned rest in the cafe half way through to sample some Butter Beer (an acquired taste!). Reasonably priced food & drink on offer. I’d recommend going in the evening as no queues to get in!

Me and my girlfriend are in our 30s and both had a blast at the studio. In our group people of all ages had gathered in love for the Harry Potter franchise and it was a truly magical experience. Also as a filmmaker and a film lover just to see the craftsmanship behind every detail is awe-inspiring to say the least. Could go on forever. But if you are at least a modest fan of HP you'll love this.
The busride is long and there are some queing before you get in, but once inside you'll be wide-eyed for at least 2,5-3 hours.
Time was sufficient to check out the entire attraction. Buses were on time and comfortable. Had a lot of fun, would definitely recommend it!
Had a great tour of Harry Potter studios, it was really nice seeing all the sets! It's a big tour, and many of the sets has people who can tell you interesting facts which I found great.
Arrived via coach with my husband and 31yr old daughter, her request. Stated i would be out in an hour, nope, fantastic, amazing and such a great tour.

This is a must visit place in London. You can see a lot of scenes, monsters, setups from the film. The museum is not for those who chase for sensory stimulation, but for Harry Potter fans who want to know more about the hidden gems behind the film.

This is not a theme park (like Universal Studio's in Orlando, for example); rather this provides official insight into the processes, props, sets, and characters of the Harry Potter movies. A truly magical experience for all ages. Food and drinks are available. Allow at least 2 hours (I needed closer to 4).

From the moment we met our guide at Euston Station, we had a blast!! It took the worry of how to get there out of the equation. After riding the train, we boarded a HP bus and were taken directly to the front entrance on WB Studio where we were introduced to our knowledgable, fun tour guide!! We had an incredibly fun time here! We completed our tour and had the option to go back through at our own pace if we so desired! Do it!!

Was unable to get tix directly through the Warner Bros site and managed to get them through Evan Evans. Effectively, you're paying for transport from Victoria to Leavesden Studio. No complaints - the bus was decent and the ride was smooth and uneventful. The service provided was also fine - we didn't face any issues. Worth it. There is a fixed time though - you get about 4 plus hours at the studio which may not be enough if you want to do everything as it seems to perpetually packed. The studio itself is totally worth it - try the butterbeer! Take pics against all the green screen opportunities. An experience not to be missed.

I loved everything about this experience. I recommend doing everything. Get on the broom and ride against the green screen. Get in line to tell the broom "up!" Try a butterbeer and eat a sandwich in the backlot cafe. Do ALL THE THINGS because nothing about it is disappointing. Also, I recommend getting there for the first entry because otherwise it's just wicked busy. 3 hours was more than enough time for us with that time slot.

A fantastic experience, whether you are a huge fan of harry potter books, movies or film making in general - the scope of the whole thing gives you an appreciation of the whole thing,

Yes as a grown adult I got my mum to buy me a wand

If you have someone in your party with special needs please do speak to the information desk and let them know. They can help with little shortcuts and they have a sensory room available if required as well.

Unfortunately we had a bit of a meltdown just after the great hall (the first room!), I saw a security guard and asked if he knew somewhere quiet we could go, he was so helpful! He got us somewhere quiet as quick as possible but unfortunately our little one didn’t come out the meltdown and we decided to call it a day.

So special shout out to Terry the security guard and Marnie who helped us and Sam from the creatures area. All fantastic.

We received instructions to call Evans Evans upon our arrival in London, to verify that we would be attending the tour. No one answered the phone, and the automated system did not make it clear which option to chose. Ultimately I left a voice mail on the some sort of accounting line, and hoped for the best. When we arrived at the designated meeting point, we were told that if we had not contacted Evans Evans, they would not pick us up. We had a few tense moments while the person at the desk, who was not affiliated with Evans Evans, called to determine if Evans Evans was sending a bus. They did and the bus arrived very promptly, and we were on our way. This "tour" was nothing more than a bus ride to and from Warner Brothers Studios. Once at the studios, we were handed our tickets and told when to meet back at the bus. We had a great time. Upon our return, which again was very prompt, we were surprised to learn that we were not being dropped off at the point at which we were picked up. We were given no advanced warning of this. When we reacted with surprise at being asked to leave the bus, the driver was so nice and offered to drop us closer to where we had been picked up originally because he was going that way anyway. We could have found our way back, after all it is London and there are tubes everywhere, but we were just a little surprised and would have liked to have know in advance that we weren't being returned to our starting point. Anyway, everything worked out, and again, the bus driver was so kind and considerate. Aside from these few surprises, we had a great time and highly recommend going to see the studio if you are a Harry Potter fan. Just be aware that if they tell you to call Evans Evans upon your arrival in London, they aren't kidding, and you just might get dropped off in a completely unfamiliar area.

The Harry Potter Studio tour was such a great experience. The bus ride is approximately 1 hour there and back and you have 4 hours to explore the museum. Know that this is basically a museum of everything Harry Potter from the 7 movies. They have costumes, sets, props etc. Much of the tour is very interactive, you go through the museum on your own at your own pace, it is very busy but they let people through in groups, you don't need to get a time ahead of time, you just wait in a que, the wait wasn't too long. They even have butterbeer to purchase. Very fun time.

Great bus service by Evan Evans - on time & great driver - thank you Paul. Breath taking studio tour whether you are a fan or not! Loved every second of our four hours and could have spent more time there. Worth every cent!

Was a little hesitant about taking this, but it turned out great. The bus ride to the studio was relaxing and a lot of areas to see. The studio was wonderful. All the staff there were terrific. A lot to see in a short period of time but well worth it.

Harry Potter Studios was much more than I expected. It truly was a magical experience. The extent of detail and focus on experience of the visit was first rate and spot on. I would highly recommend it to anyone, obviously Harry Potter fans but it offered much, much more. The explanation of technical detail about how the film was made was excellent. It would be a great school visit, expecially linked with a careers day as the films pulled in such a varied amount of job roles. There were three people in my party and we all had a fabulous day out which was well worth the money.

Really enjoyed our recent trip, I’ve 2 Harry Potter fans aged 4 & 7 and they were enthralled throughout!! We booked last minute so had to book via Golden Tours but that included bus journey there and back (in a Harry Potter themed bus that played a HP movie which was an added bonus) it’s a really spectacular tour, lots of interesting facts about movie, would be happy to go back again as no doubt we missed lots as there’s so much to see! Definitely recommend!

Definitely 5 stars for my daughter. I enjoyed parts of it and the videos are surprisingly informative. Not like those crap extras you get in the dvds. Still I needed the beer at lunch to make it to the end. Three hours are not enough. You need about 4.5 but we left after 4 in order to make our bus. The bus ride was efficient and relaxing which I can't say is always the case.

The actual WB studio was fantastic! But don't be under the illusion that this is a tour, it's not, its transport
After working in travel for 10 years and a husband as a tour director for 15 years, when someone states they are a tour director I have a couple of expectations.
As we boarded the guide said 'welcome aboard' then sat down and put on a video. When we got there he was a bit brash in saying don't leave the coach while he got tickets... ok, that's fine, but my issue came on departure. He got on board said goodbye and stayed there while leaving his trusty driver to look after the passengers.
WB tour was amazing... Evan Evan's was 'meh'

This attraction is excellent even if you are not an avid Harry Potter fan. There is so much to see and do! Definitely worth the time and money. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is because during the coach ride there there was no information given about the areas of London we were passing through. Otherwise very well organized tour operators.
This was the most fantastic experience in my life. Enjoyed this so much! I really would go another time😍

This place is great for Harry Potter fans of all ages. There is so much to see and do. We were there with 2 kids and spent over 4 hours going around. Make sure you leave enough time to do everything, flying a broomstick is a great experience. Also having a butterbeer in the cafe in the middle is a must do. The shop at the end is amazing with some great souvenirs. If we lived closer a return trip would definately be happening

It was an amazing experience. You would find yourself in a magical place with all the props wigs and costume. You'd be surprised by all the details in every scene. Don't forget to have a ride on the magical broom stick.

Well!what can a harry potter fan say for this trip.It was phenomenal and one feels as if you r in the film set itself.all of us enjoyed the butter beer there.dont miss this attraction at any cost ,but kindly book this attraction atleast two months in advance as the entry tickets get sold out pretty fast,they have also opened a new part called forbidden forest which is too good for words.

From the HP train, Great Hall, and Platform 9 3/4, to the numerous set props, wigs, costumes, artwork, miniature set designs and flying broom stick VR experiences, I would recommend this for HP fans of all ages! So many possible photo-ops. I personally liked trying to find all of the hidden snitches; I only missed finding 2! I highly encourage visiting this place even when some areas were closed off when we visited.

I went on the 31st December early morning trip to the Harry Potter Studios. The whole thing was very well organised. Everyone had been asked to arrive by 8.30am for departure at 8.45am. No matter how many visits to Universal, if you're a Harry Potter fan, don't miss The Making of Harry Potter at the Warner Bros venue. If you don't want to wait months to get tickets, book a tour online. The place is amazing. Four or five hours isn't nearly enough time to take it all in. The design, sets, interactive opportunities are a feast for the eyes, movie goers, designers & engineers. Personally, I'd skip renting the audio/ video set unless you are hearing impaired if there's a lot of background noise or aren't fluent in English. Every video is on repeat play at each exhibit. One of our sets stopped working due to dead battery after the 3rd exhibit; since it wasn't very useful, we didn't bother looking for an associate to get a replacement. So no refund. No way. We were told in no uncertain terms that the fault was ours. Oh well. While we had a fabulous experience with extremely helpful and knowledgeable staff, great lunch & snack (I highly recommend the half size burger--- and a butter beer) -- we were quickly brought back to Warner Bros corporate at the very end when we told staff to change the batteries on a headset rather than throw it in with ones that work -- and not be offered some kind of token souvenir if refund wasn't in the cards. Everyone in show biz knows to leave the audience happy.... despite this lost opportunity, we had a fabulous afternoon.

Lots of fun things to see and if you're a Harry Potter fan you will definitely enjoy. Some of the queues were pretty long but all in all a good exprience.

The studio and tour was an amazing experience! If you love Harry Potter, trust me when I say you'll regret not coming to visit if you're in London. I'd wanted to come here for years, and it did not disappoint. If I could come back again, I most definitely would! It's just a shame I live 24 hours' flight away, otherwise I might spend far too much time and money here.
Sets are really creative and artistic. It was interesting to see the wizarding world come alive. So magical and entertaining.

The studio and the tour were awesome!!! Highly recommend! We would have liked another 30 minutes or an hour, but it was a great take.

The guide basically gives you your ticket, an arm band, and a piece of paper with instructions on how to get back to London if you choose to do so early. The allotted time, if you stop for a snack and butter beer, is perfect. The bus was clean and the drive was fine. The Studio itself is amazing. Give yourself time to shop. We actually shopped before we went in and bought our stuff. When we went in at the end of the day, so much was picked over! Having one person handing out tickets and bracelets and checking people off on a printed list is very inefficient and resulted in a long wait and a delay. Suggest to let people pick up their tickets in advance and use a computer to find people.

Suggests that people can select the number of hours they want in the studio and then you arrange home transport according to when people wish to be picked up instead of defining the time people have.

I booked through Evan Evan's because you must buy tickets in advance for the studio tour, and this was the only place I could find tickets on short notice. The tour was great! But ride not so much. Going the air conditioning didn't work and neither did the wifi. Coming back they did not tell us where to meet the bus. The bus was 30 minutes late. Absolutely amazing and magical visit .....my two children and I (they're 27 and 25) are massive Harry Potter fans and this tour ticked every box for us. As a big fan of the Wizarding World of HP, this trip was a must for me. We had to wait for the Golden Tours bus at King's Cross / St. Pancras at 9:15, with a 9:30 departure. So, no hassle with renting a car and finding the way out of the city at rush hour. We arrived at WB Studios at 11:00. Our time slot was a 11:30.

The tour is divided over 2 halls/hangars, with a restaurant and a outside section in the middle. The first hall you learn a lot about the sets, the locations, CGI/special effects, filming techniques, etc. The second hall you'll learn about make-up, costumes, sketches, scale models, etc. In the middle, outside, you'll find the Knightbus, the Privet Drive, Godric's Hollow, and the Wooden Bridge (from the Deathly Hallows films). We bought the Warner Bros. Studio tour from this company at double price because the tickets directly from the studio were sold out way in advance. When we reached the tour office and were given a wristband, the return time to the bus said 4:20PM! I asked why that would be the case since we are supposed to reach the tour office back by 6:00PM (meaning the bus could start back from the studios by 4:45 PM and still reach back on time). The very rude and semi-educated staff proceeded to lecture me in a condescending way as if I had misunderstood the itinerary. I gave her a piece of my mind and then she told me “Please don’t talk to me like this”! As if, I am not allowed to ask questions about my money’s worth. Now here is how the day went - the bus started at 11:05 PM. Not a big deal, only 5 mins late. It reached the studio at 12:20. By the time you actually start your tour after the introduction and orientation by WB Studios, it takes another 40 mins. The actual tour therefore started at 1:00. With a lunch break, gift shop and walking back to the bus to be there by 4:20PM, we got ONLY 3 hours to spend in the studio. It was very rushed with 2 small children. In fact, I had 2 skip some sections so I could stand in line for lunch while my kids toured the courtyard section. We boarded the bus on time at 4:20 and were dropped off at 5:30 near the Victorian tube station. Just as I suspected they short changed us by at-least 30 mins. They could have asked us to be back by 4:45 PM and given us the extra 25-30 mins. My recommendation - Ditch them and book your own tickets in advance directly from the studio (costs half) and take the very nice London public transport to get to the studios (kids under 11 are free on most trains with an Oyster Card). Evans - you can fool some people some times but you cannot fool all the people all the time! This business is deceptive and should be shut down.

I loved the time here, was worth the money, my children love Harry Potter and this was certainly a good day out for them!

The trip was amazing! Me and my friend enjoyed every minute, and even got hit by the feels, when we entered the room with the Hogwarts model. Music from the movie was played, and true Harry Potter fans will really get hit by all the emotions.

We love harry potter (the books) and had to go see it all in person. It was such a fun experience! If you are a harry potter fan, there is nothing like getting to see your favorite stories in real life. You get to visit Hagrid's hut and the Weasley's kitchen, see all the outfits and props (the philosopher's stone!!) you get to see Dobby and the potions classroom and Umbridge (ugh). Literally, you get to see everything. There are models and character drawings, you get to sit in a train coach and get aboard the Hogwarts Express from the movie. We are in our 30s and we LOVED it. Definitely an experience for all ages and worth the money and time if you love Harry Potter.

My daughter is a Harry potter fan and grew up with his movies. For her, it was a magical afternoon. She could relate to the many displays, sets & items. I have not seen all the movies so the finer details were lost on me. However, the setup and layout kept me engaged as it is mind blowing to see the efforts that went into the making of these movies. 4 hours and money well spent!

This was a disappointing and expensive excursion, and I think in hindsight, we probably would have skipped it. My teenage daughters are huge Harry Potter fans, read all 8 books more than three times and we regularly watch the movies at home. They thought it was interesting and neat, but did not find it a "must-do". This could be because we've visited both Universal Studio's Harry Potter Worlds and I do understand they are different types of experiences, but I think we enjoyed that a lot more.

Our tickets were for 6:00 PM and we arrived at 4:00 PM and they allowed us to enter at 4:35 PM. We spent approximately two hours there and did stop for a drink and some butterbeer. There are a few interactive photo ops and activities for the kids, but my teens did not partake.

Harry Potter is step by step broken down here.. From hidden snitches to the magnificent gift shop full of sweets, all Harry Potter fans will not only point out each part in the films once going here but if you’re not much of a fan you’ll become one after seeing the dedication that went into this film Xx 😚
Very crowded and hard to actually see anything. Cafe food is of temp and overpriced. The place is nice though...

Harry Potter Studio was phenomenal. We took our 2 year old and 12 year old and it was awesome. If you love Potter, then you will love this. Worth every penny! Reserve way ahead of time to get your tickets. Finding the golden tours office at Victoria was a nightmare. No one was helpful. Luckily we saw a man who worked with them and he showed us where to go. The directions suck! Other then that, we were good. More then I expected. Felt as if I was in the movie. Sets were unbelievable.

We took the Golden Tours tour from Victoria station, and it was right on time and very comfortable. The kids had a good time on the upper deck and they had a good view of London and a bit of the countryside.

I promised my granddaughter that I would take her here for her 10th birthday. she is a Harry Potter enthusiast, has read all the books, has her room decorated with pennants, posters and other HP paraphernalia. I had read the books so would not be completely out of it. ButI think I git more out of it than she did. It is filled with information about filming, how creatures and characters were created, their maturation in the filming process as the years went by, has incredible models of beasts, buildings etc. and is a wonderful site. If you know anything about the movies, it is worth a visit.

I loved that they were prompt about their departure times because we made to the studio on time and had enough time to complete the tour, have lunch, and shop without feeling rushed! The bus driver and other staff were super friendly and professional! My kids and I loved the trip!

Great tour, everything went smoothly, the bus left at the exact time stated and the tour guide was very funny and informative, he even dropped us off at our place in the end. Highly recommended and would use them again.

Booked through Evan Evans Tours about a week before we went, very easy booking. Coach was comfortable and spotless. Driver was great, very handy with the drop offs on the return journey. My only thing would be I found the return time for the bus too far off the arrival time, we were waiting around after the tour for over an hour, as were most other on our tour.

Booked the Harry Potter tour through Evan Evans. Everything was seamless and easy! Bus was comfortable and relaxing. Tour itself was amazing. Bus driver very accommodating with convenient drop-offs on return trip. Highly recommend!!
Efficient transport, very helpful staff and an amazing tour of Harry Potter's world. I really think it was a pefect day and would love to join the tour again.
Great in every way better then expected 😀😀😀😀the grandkids age 10 & 13 have been looking forward to it and we're not disappointed 👍👍👍👍

I booked the tour for Dec 14th and request an amendement for Dec 15th. Well it's a little bit confusing at first since they need me to contact the agent and the agent said I need to contact them but in the end, they amended my booking after I contacted both of Evan Evans Tours and Viator through some emails ( I booked through Viator). The trip was easy, just need to go from hotel to Evan Evans Office and their bus would take you to Warner bross studio and then take you back to London. The tour was super fun, as all Harry Potter's fans would say.
Very interesting tour, a lot to see and enjoy. Most recommend. Was there with my 13 years old child, he and me had a great time.

The Harry Potter Warner brothers tour was a must for me during my trip, and i loved it!
Evan Evans made this all very simple. I travelled to the office and waited with everyone else for the tour bus. E-voucher makes everything simple.
they drive you to the studio and give you your tickets, the rest is up to you.
It was a great day!
